# Atlantic Highly Migratory Species Pelagic Observer Program CPUE {#hms_cpue}

**Description**: CPUE from pelagic observer program (POP) observed hauls, presented as number of fish per haul, is provided for the northeast (i.e., the Northeast Coastal and Mid-Atlantic Bight fishing areas) by year/species from 1992-2023.

**Indicator category**: Database pull with analysis

**Found in**: State of the Ecosystem - Gulf of Maine & Georges Bank (2021+), State of the Ecosystem - Mid-Atlantic (2021+), State of the Ecosystem - Indicator Catalog (2024+)

**Contributor(s)**: Jennifer Cudney, Tobey Curtis, Daniel Daye
  
**Data steward**:  Jennifer Cudney, Tobey Curtis, Daniel Daye
  
**Point of contact**:  Jennifer Cudney <jennifer.cudney@noaa.gov>
  
**Public availability statement**: Source data are NOT publicly available. Pelagic observer data is considered confidential data, and must be screened to ensure that data meet requirements for "rule of three" at the set and vessel level before they can be distributed.

## Methods

### Data sources

NOAA Southeast Fisheries Science Center, Pelagic Observer Program.  Data can be requested using this form (https://forms.gle/kiMGRfUwbKJCf8Vs6). For more information regarding the dataset please see the SEFSC POP InPort catalog entry (https://www.fisheries.noaa.gov/inport/item/30713). For data requests contact popobserver@noaa.gov.

### Data analysis

Catch per unit effort was calculated as number of animals caught per haul and summarized by year and species/management group. 

HMS staff created graphs that can be used in technical documentation and in the upcoming SOE report. The graphs were created by plotting the data from each tab in the “HMS POP CPUE 1992-2024” file in R. CPUE (# fish / # hauls) are plotted on the y-axis, and year is plotted on the x-axis.

### Data processing 

Data requests are submitted to the Pelagic Observer Program staff using this request form (https://forms.gle/kiMGRfUwbKJCf8Vs6) or by contacting popobserver@noaa.gov. Data from the areas (combined from pelagic observer program reporting areas “MAB” and “NEC”) are summarized by species (or management group) and year. Number of hauls per year are also provided to enable CPUE calculations of species per year. Data only include HMS managed under the Atlantic HMS Fishery Management Plan and its amendments.
